# NewsAPI.ai

> NewsAPI.ai is the news API of Event Registry: real-time and archive (since 2014) access to news, blog and press-release articles from 150,000+ publishers in 50+ languages. Every article is enriched with entities (concepts linked to Wikipedia), categories, sentiment, locations and duplicate information; related articles are clustered into events, and Signal Types classify 136+ kinds of real-world developments (mergers, layoffs, protests, wildfires, ...) at the sentence level. Access is via a REST API (JSON over GET or POST), Python and Node.js SDKs, and an MCP server.

This is the complete, single-file reference for LLMs and AI coding assistants. A shorter index is at https://newsapi.ai/llms.txt and the human-readable documentation at https://newsapi.ai/documentation.

## Quick start

1. Register for free at https://newsapi.ai/register (2,000 tokens, no credit card) and copy the API key from https://newsapi.ai/dashboard.
2. Find the URI of what you are looking for (person, company, place, topic) with an autosuggest endpoint. Concept URIs match the entity in every language, which keywords do not.
3. Search articles or events, filtering by concept, keyword, source, category, language, date, sentiment and more.

Find the concept URI for "Tesla":

```bash
curl -X POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/suggestConceptsFast \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prefix": "Tesla", "lang": "eng", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY"}'
# -> [{"uri": "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesla,_Inc.", "type": "org", "label": {"eng": "Tesla, Inc."}, ...}, ...]
```

The 20 newest English articles about Tesla from the last 7 days, without duplicates:

```bash
curl -X POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/article/getArticles \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "conceptUri": "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesla,_Inc.",
    "lang": "eng",
    "forceMaxDataTimeWindow": 7,
    "isDuplicateFilter": "skipDuplicates",
    "articlesSortBy": "date",
    "articlesCount": 20,
    "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY"
  }'
# -> {"articles": {"totalResults": ..., "page": 1, "pages": ..., "results": [{"uri", "url", "title", "body", "dateTime", "source": {...}, "sentiment", "eventUri", ...}]}}
```

The same with the Python SDK (`pip install eventregistry`):

```python
from eventregistry import *
# allowUseOfArchive=False keeps queries without dates to the last 30 days (cheapest token tier)
er = EventRegistry(apiKey = "YOUR_API_KEY", allowUseOfArchive = False)

q = QueryArticlesIter(
    conceptUri = er.getConceptUri("Tesla"),
    lang = "eng",
    dataType = ["news", "pr"])

for art in q.execQuery(er, sortBy = "date", maxItems = 20):
    print(art["dateTime"], art["source"]["title"], art["title"])
```

Tips for writing correct requests:

- Prefer `conceptUri` (from `suggestConceptsFast`) over `keyword` for entities; use `keyword` for phrases that are not entities.
- Keep searches in the cheap "recent" tier (last 30 days) with `forceMaxDataTimeWindow` (7 or 31) or a `dateStart`/`dateEnd` within the last 30 days; each searched archive year costs more tokens (see §1.7).
- One call returns at most 100 articles (`articlesCount`) or 50 events (`eventsCount`); page with `articlesPage` / `eventsPage`. For real-time ingestion use the minute streams instead of polling searches.
- Send at most 5 requests at the same time (HTTP 429 otherwise); sequential requests are recommended.
- For AND/OR/NOT combinations use the `query` parameter (§1.15) and do not mix it with simple filter parameters.
- `includeArticleConcepts`, `includeArticleCategories`, `includeArticleLocation` and other `include*` flags (§1.18) add fields that are off by default.

## Product overview

- Coverage: 150,000+ publishers, 50+ languages, news since 2014, real-time updates; data types `news`, `blog` and `pr` (press releases).
- Enrichment: concepts (people, organizations, locations, things; Wikipedia URIs), categories (IPTC Media Topics, DMOZ, News taxonomies), sentiment, dateline location, extracted dates, authors, images, duplicate detection, source ranking.
- Events: articles about the same real-world happening, in any language, are grouped into events with a title, summary, date, location, concepts and categories.
- Signal Types: 136+ event types (Business 87, Society 27, Environment 22) detected at the sentence level, with facticity (fact / opinion / forecast), entities, sentiment and ESG / SDG / SASB framework mappings. Overview: https://newsapi.ai/signal-types
- Text analytics on your own text: semantic annotation, named entities, categorization, sentiment, semantic similarity, language detection and article extraction from a URL.
- Pricing: token-based monthly plans at https://newsapi.ai/plans; free tier of 2,000 tokens on registration. Use cases: media monitoring, risk monitoring, market and geopolitical intelligence, news aggregation, data mining.

---

## 1. Conventions

### 1.1 Hosts

| API group | Base URL |
|---|---|
| Articles, Events, Event Types (mentions), Autosuggest, Usage | `https://eventregistry.org` (paths start with `/api/v1/...`; the same paths also work on `https://newsapi.ai`) |
| Text Analytics | `https://analytics.eventregistry.org/api/v1` |

### 1.2 Authentication

- Pass your key as the `apiKey` parameter on every call. Use a URL query parameter for GET or a JSON body field for POST. There is no header-based auth.
- Register for free at https://newsapi.ai/register; after you log in, your API key is shown on https://newsapi.ai/dashboard. A free account gets **2,000 tokens** in total for testing. A paid plan is required to use more.

### 1.3 HTTP method and body

- Every endpoint accepts **GET or POST**.
  - With **GET**, send parameters in the URL query string.
  - With **POST**, send them as a JSON object in the request body with header `Content-Type: application/json`.
- Some requests require POST, for example when the request is too long for a URL. Use POST whenever you send the `query` object or long lists.
- With GET, a multi-valued parameter is sent by repeating it. With POST, use a JSON array, for example `"lang": ["eng","deu"]`.
- Many documentation examples include an `"action"` field (e.g. `"action": "getArticles"`). The path already identifies the action, so this field is optional.

### 1.4 Response codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Success |
| 204 | Request succeeded, but the requested information is not available |
| 400 | Bad request: invalid or missing parameter |
| 401 | User's token limit reached; requests are rejected |
| 403 | Forbidden: the IP or account is disabled, or all tokens have been used (see the error message) |
| 429 | Too many simultaneous requests |
| 500 | Internal error |
| 503 | Service unavailable |

### 1.5 Rate limiting

- A user can have at most **5 simultaneous requests**. Any extra request gets a `429` and is not executed.
- The recommended approach is to send requests sequentially rather than in parallel.

### 1.6 Limits on query conditions (items per condition type per query)

| Condition | Trial | Paid |
|---|---|---|
| Sources | 1,000 | 50,000 |
| Keywords | 15 | 60 |
| Concepts | 15 | 60 |
| Categories | 10 | 20 |
| Languages | 5 | 10 |
| Locations | 10 | 15 |

Individual parameter descriptions also give per-parameter limits, which are the paid limits. Examples: at most 60 keywords, 50 concepts, 20 categories or 5 languages per search.

### 1.7 Token usage

Two things determine the cost of a request:

- **What you request**: article search, event search, an aggregate, or text analytics.
- **The time period covered**: recent data (last 30 days) has a fixed low cost. Archive data (since 2014) is charged per searched year.

| Request type | Recent data (last 30 days) | Archive (since 2014) |
|---|---|---|
| Search articles | 1 token | 5 tokens / searched year |
| Search events | 5 tokens | 20 tokens / searched year |
| Simple aggregates (top concepts, tag cloud, locations, timeline, sources, sentiment, concept graph, categories) | 5 tokens | 10 tokens / searched year |
| Complex aggregates (concept trends, date mentions, event clustering, similar events) | 10 tokens | 50 tokens / searched year |

Text analytics is charged per analyzed document:

| Endpoint | Tokens per document |
|---|---|
| Language detection | 0.01 |
| Named entity detection | 0.02 |
| Sentiment detection | 0.02 |
| Semantic annotation | 0.04 |
| Text categorization | 0.04 |
| Semantic text similarity | 0.05 |
| Extract article info | 0.05 |

Further cost notes:

- A search call counts as one search action no matter how many results it returns (up to 100 articles or 50 events per call).
- `getArticle` (article details) costs the same as an article search.
- Stream endpoints charge per returned batch:
  - `minuteStreamArticles` uses one token per started 100 articles. For example, 250 articles cost 3 tokens.
  - `minuteStreamEvents` uses 5 tokens per 50 events. For example, 200 events cost 4×5 tokens.
- To keep searches in the cheap "recent" tier, set `dateStart`/`dateEnd` or `forceMaxDataTimeWindow`.
- `GET /api/v1/usage` returns `availableTokens` and `usedTokens`.

### 1.8 `forceMaxDataTimeWindow`

- Integer, valid values **7** or **31** only.
- It limits the search to the last 7 or 31 days without setting `dateStart`/`dateEnd`, which ensures the smallest token use.
- Omit it to search older data.
- Available on `getArticles` and `getEvents`.

### 1.9 `dataType`

- Values: `news` (default), `pr` (press releases), `blog`. Pass a string or an array, for example `["news","pr"]`.
- Available on article searches and article streams.
- In the advanced query language, set it inside `$filter.dataType`.

### 1.10 `resultType` and parameter prefixes

- Search endpoints return either a list of items or one of several **aggregates**, selected with `resultType`:
  - `getArticles` defaults to `articles`.
  - `getEvents` defaults to `events`.
  - `getMentions` defaults to `mentions`.
  - `getEvent` and `getArticle` default to `info`.
- The paging, sorting and body-length parameters of a result type carry that result type as a prefix. Examples:
  - `articlesPage`, `articlesCount`, `articlesSortBy`
  - `eventsPage`, `eventsCount`, `eventsSortBy`
  - `mentionsPage`, `mentionsCount`, `mentionsSortBy`
  - `breakingEventsCount`, `breakingEventsPage`
  - `recentActivityArticlesMaxArticleCount`
  - `infoArticleBodyLen`
  - `articleTrendLang`, `articleTrendPage`, `articleTrendCount`
- In the documentation's `getEvent` description: "Each result type corresponds to the prefix that'll be used for other parameters."
- Aggregate responses have the shape `{ "<resultType>": { "warning"?, "usedResults", "totalResults", "results": [...] } }`.
- List responses have the shape `{ "<resultType>": { "totalResults", "page", "count", "pages", "results": [...] } }`.

### 1.11 Paging limits

| Endpoint | Page parameter | Count parameter | Default / max count |
|---|---|---|---|
| getArticles, getArticlesForTopicPage | `articlesPage` (from 1) | `articlesCount` | 100 / 100 |
| getEvents, getEventsForTopicPage | `eventsPage` | `eventsCount` | 50 / 50 |
| getMentions | `mentionsPage` | `mentionsCount` | 100 / 100 |
| getBreakingEvents | `breakingEventsPage` | `breakingEventsCount` | 100 / 100 |
| getArticle | – (up to 100 `articleUri` values per call) | – | – |
| minuteStreamArticles | – | `recentActivityArticlesMaxArticleCount` | 100 / 2000 |
| minuteStreamEvents | – | `recentActivityEventsMaxEventCount` | 50 / 2000 |

To retrieve more results, repeat the call and increase the page parameter (2, 3, ...).

### 1.12 Sorting

- **Articles** (`articlesSortBy`, `mentionsSortBy`):
  - `date` (default): publishing date
  - `rel`: relevance to the query
  - `sourceImportance`: manually curated source importance
  - `sourceAlexaGlobalRank`
  - `sourceAlexaCountryRank`
  - The text also mentions `sourceImportanceRank` (the reverse of `sourceImportance`), but it is not in the enum.
  - `articlesSortByAsc` / `mentionsSortByAsc`: `false` (default) sorts descending.
- **Events** (`eventsSortBy`):
  - `date` (default for `getEvents`)
  - `rel` (default for `getEventsForTopicPage`)
  - `size`: number of articles in the event
  - `eventsSortByAsc` defaults to `false`.

### 1.13 Simple query parameters

On search endpoints you can set filter parameters directly. These rules apply:

- **Different condition types** combine with AND.
- **Repeated values of one parameter**:
  - `keyword`: AND by default. Change with `keywordOper` (`and`|`or`).
  - `conceptUri`: AND by default. Change with `conceptOper`.
  - `categoryUri`: **OR** by default. Change with `categoryOper`.
  - `sourceUri`, `sourceLocationUri`, `sourceGroupUri`, `authorUri`, `locationUri`, `lang`: OR (any value matches).
- **Negative conditions** use `ignore*` parameters (`ignoreKeyword`, `ignoreConceptUri`, `ignoreCategoryUri`, `ignoreSourceUri`, `ignoreSourceLocationUri`, `ignoreSourceGroupUri`, `ignoreAuthorUri`, `ignoreLocationUri`, `ignoreLang`, `ignoreKeywordLoc`). A result matching **any** ignore value is excluded.
- **Value formats**:
  - Dates use `YYYY-MM-DD`.
  - Times (`onlyAfterTm`, `*UpdatesAfterTm`) use `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` in UTC.
  - Languages use ISO 639-3 codes (see §1.20).
- **Where the URIs come from**:
  - `conceptUri`: Wikipedia URLs such as `http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barack_Obama`. Look them up via [Suggest concepts](#suggest-concepts).
  - `categoryUri`: e.g. `dmoz/Business`, `news/Business`.
  - `sourceUri`: the source's domain, e.g. `bbc.co.uk`.
  - `locationUri`: the Wikipedia URL of the place.
  - `authorUri`: e.g. `mark_mazzetti@nytimes.com`.
  - `sourceGroupUri`: e.g. `general/ERtop10`, `business/top100`, `paywall/paywalled_sources`.

Example of a simple query: every condition must match. The doc example repeats the `conceptUri` key. With GET this means repeating the parameter; with POST use an array.

```json
{
  "conceptUri": ["http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenAI", "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_(company)"],
  "keyword": "AWS",
  "categoryUri": "news/Business",
  "sourceGroupUri": "business/top100",
  "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY"
}
```

### 1.14 Keyword search modes (`keywordSearchMode`)

| Mode | Behavior | Use when |
|---|---|---|
| `phrase` (default) | Exact phrase: all words adjacent and in order | Looking for a specific term, product or company |
| `exact` | Boolean language inside one `keyword` string: `AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, `NEXT/X` (in order, at most X words apart), `NEAR/X` (within X words, any order), and parentheses. Consecutive non-operator words form a phrase. Precedence: `NEAR/x`, `NEXT/x` > `NOT` > `AND` > `OR` | Combining or excluding terms, or requiring proximity |
| `simple` | Google-like relevance search: not all terms are required; more matches rank higher | Long free-text topic descriptions. Combine with `articlesSortBy: "rel"` |

- `keywordLoc` sets where keywords are searched: `body` (default), `title`, or `body,title`.
- Several phrases with `keywordOper`: `"keyword": ["electric vehicle","charging station"], "keywordOper": "and"`.

Examples of the `exact` mode:

```json
{ "keyword": "(Apple OR Samsung) AND smartphone NOT lawsuit", "keywordSearchMode": "exact", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
{ "keyword": "Siemens NEAR/15 (sustainability OR ecology OR renewable energy)", "keywordSearchMode": "exact", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
{ "keyword": "tesla self driving car number of fatal accidents", "keywordSearchMode": "simple", "articlesSortBy": "rel", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

### 1.15 Advanced query language (`query` parameter)

- For nested AND/OR/NOT logic, pass a JSON object in the `query` parameter. The syntax resembles MongoDB.
- When you use `query`, **do not** also pass simple filter parameters such as `keyword`, `conceptUri` or `sourceUri`:
  - The query-language docs say combining them returns an error.
  - The `getEvents` docs say the simple parameters are ignored.
- The same language is used by `getArticles`, `getEvents` and `getMentions`. `getMentions` adds event-type fields; see §5.

Grammar (articles):

```
ComplexArticleQuery ::= {
  "$query": CombinedQuery | BaseQuery,
  "$filter": null | {
    "dataType": null | "news" | "blog" | "pr" | ["news", ...],
    "isDuplicate": null | "keepAll" | "skipDuplicates" | "keepOnlyDuplicates",
    "hasEvent": null | "keepAll" | "skipArticlesWithoutEvent" | "keepOnlyArticlesWithoutEvent",
    "startSourceRankPercentile": null | 0 | 10 | ... | 90,
    "endSourceRankPercentile": null | 10 | 20 | ... | 100,
    "minSentiment": null | float([-1,1]),
    "maxSentiment": null | float([-1,1])
  }
}
CombinedQuery ::= { "$or":  [ CombinedQuery | BaseQuery, ... ], "$not": null | CombinedQuery | BaseQuery }
CombinedQuery ::= { "$and": [ CombinedQuery | BaseQuery, ... ], "$not": null | CombinedQuery | BaseQuery }
BaseQuery ::= {
  "conceptUri":  null | string | {"$or":[string,...]} | {"$and":[string,...]},
  "keyword":     null | string | {"$or":[string,...]} | {"$and":[string,...]},
  "categoryUri": null | string | {"$or":[string,...]} | {"$and":[string,...]},
  "lang":        null | string | {"$or":[string,...]} | {"$and":[string,...]},
  "sourceUri":         null | string | {"$or":[string,...]},
  "sourceLocationUri": null | string | {"$or":[string,...]},
  "sourceGroupUri":    null | string | {"$or":[string,...]},
  "authorUri":   null | string | {"$or":[string,...]} | {"$and":[string,...]},
  "locationUri": null | string | {"$or":[string,...]},
  "dateStart": null | string, "dateEnd": null | string, "dateMention": null | [string, ...],
  "keywordLoc": null | "body" | "title" | "title,body",
  "keywordSearchMode": null | "simple" | "exact" | "phrase",
  "minArticlesInEvent": null | int, "maxArticlesInEvent": null | int,
  "$not": null | CombinedQuery | BaseQuery
}
```

Semantics:

- **Query structure**
  - `$query` is required.
  - `$and` means all sub-queries must match; `$or` means any must match.
  - `$not` excludes matches.
  - A `BaseQuery` with several fields requires all of them to match.
  - A `BaseQuery` that contains only `$not` is invalid.
- **`$filter`**
  - Holds the data type, duplicate handling and event-membership handling.
  - It also holds the source-rank percentile window. Example: start 0 and end 20 keeps roughly the top 20% of sources by global Alexa rank.

Example 1: articles about AI, or that mention "deep learning" or "machine learning". Exclude articles with "data mining" in the title. Keep only positive sentiment and drop duplicates.

```json
{
  "query": {
    "$query": {
      "$or": [
        { "conceptUri": "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_Intelligence" },
        { "keyword": { "$or": ["deep learning", "machine learning"] } }
      ],
      "$not": { "keyword": "data mining", "keywordLoc": "title" }
    },
    "$filter": { "minSentiment": 0.2, "isDuplicate": "skipDuplicates" }
  },
  "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY"
}
```

Example 2: politics articles about both Trump and Clinton, or business articles about Elon Musk.

```json
{
  "query": { "$query": { "$or": [
    { "conceptUri": { "$and": ["http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_Trump", "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hillary_Rodham_Clinton"] },
      "categoryUri": "dmoz/Society/Politics" },
    { "conceptUri": "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elon_Musk", "categoryUri": "dmoz/Business" }
  ] } },
  "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY"
}
```

### 1.16 Shared article filter parameters

These are used by `getArticles`, `minuteStreamArticles` (subset), `getEvent` (subset, filtering the event's articles) and, with adaptations, `getMentions`. Types are `string | string[]` unless stated otherwise.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | object | – | Advanced query (§1.15). Do not combine with the simple filters. |
| `keyword` | str/str[] | – | Keyword or phrase (max 60). Multiple values combine with AND unless `keywordOper=or`. |
| `conceptUri` | str/str[] | – | Concept URI (max 50). Multiple values combine with AND unless `conceptOper=or`. |
| `categoryUri` | str/str[] | – | Category URI (max 20). Multiple values combine with OR unless `categoryOper=and`. Child categories are included. |
| `sourceUri` | str/str[] | – | Source URI (domain). Multiple values combine with OR. |
| `sourceLocationUri` | str/str[] | – | Location (city or country) of the publishing source. |
| `sourceGroupUri` | str/str[] | – | Predefined source group, e.g. `general/ERtop10`. |
| `authorUri` | str/str[] | – | Author URI, e.g. `mark_mazzetti@nytimes.com`. |
| `locationUri` | str/str[] | – | Location named in the article **dateline**. Articles without a dateline location are not returned. Use `conceptUri` for any mention of a place. |
| `lang` | str/str[] | all | ISO3 language codes (max 5). |
| `dateStart` / `dateEnd` | string | – | Publish-date range (inclusive), `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `dateMentionStart` / `dateMentionEnd` | string | – | The article explicitly mentions a date at or after the start / at or before the end. |
| `keywordLoc` | string | `body` | `body`, `title`, `body,title`. |
| `keywordOper` | string | `and` | `and` or `or`. |
| `keywordSearchMode` | string | `phrase` | `phrase`, `exact`, `simple` (§1.14). |
| `conceptOper` | string | `and` | `and` or `or`. |
| `categoryOper` | string | `or` | `and` or `or`. |
| `ignoreKeyword`, `ignoreConceptUri`, `ignoreCategoryUri`, `ignoreSourceUri`, `ignoreSourceLocationUri`, `ignoreSourceGroupUri`, `ignoreLocationUri`, `ignoreAuthorUri`, `ignoreLang` | str/str[] | – | Exclude articles matching **any** given value. Limits match the positive parameters. |
| `ignoreKeywordLoc` | string | `body` | Where to search the `ignoreKeyword` values. |
| `startSourceRankPercentile` | int | 0 | Source-rank percentile start, 0–90, a multiple of 10. |
| `endSourceRankPercentile` | int | 100 | Source-rank percentile end, 10–100, a multiple of 10. |
| `minSentiment` / `maxSentiment` | float | – | Sentiment bounds in [-1, 1]. Setting either limits results to English. |
| `isDuplicateFilter` | string | `keepAll` | `skipDuplicates`, `keepOnlyDuplicates`, `keepAll`. |
| `eventFilter` | string | `keepAll` | `skipArticlesWithoutEvent`, `keepOnlyArticlesWithoutEvent`, `keepAll`. |

### 1.17 Shared event filter parameters

These are used by `getEvents` and, as a subset, `minuteStreamEvents`. They match the article filters except as follows:

- **Concepts**: `conceptUri` matches events where the concept is *important*.
- **Source filters**: `sourceUri`, `sourceLocationUri`, `sourceGroupUri` and `authorUri` match events that contain at least one matching article.
- **Location**: `locationUri` is where the event occurred.
- **Language**: `lang` matches events with articles in that language.
- **Event date**:
  - `dateStart` / `dateEnd` filter on the **event date**. The event date is extracted from the articles and can differ from their publishing dates.
  - `reportingDateStart` / `reportingDateEnd` filter on the average publishing date of the event's articles.
- **Sentiment**: `minSentimentEvent` / `maxSentimentEvent` (float, -1..1; English-covered events only).
- **Size**: `minArticlesInEvent` / `maxArticlesInEvent` (int, counted across all languages).
- **Mentioned dates**: `dateMentionStart` / `dateMentionEnd`.
- **Operators and negation**: `keywordLoc`, `keywordOper`, `keywordSearchMode`, `conceptOper`, `categoryOper` and the `ignore*` parameters work as for articles.
- **Not available for events**: source-rank percentiles, `isDuplicateFilter`, `eventFilter`.

### 1.18 Returned details (`include*` flags)

Set these flags to choose which fields appear in returned objects. Each endpoint section says which groups it accepts. Booleans default as shown.

| Group | Parameter (default) |
|---|---|
| Article | `includeArticleTitle` (true), `includeArticleBasicInfo` (true), `includeArticleBody` (true), `includeArticleEventUri` (true), `includeArticleSocialScore` (false), `includeArticleSentiment` (true; non-null only for English), `includeArticleConcepts` (false), `includeArticleCategories` (false), `includeArticleLocation` (false), `includeArticleImage` (true), `includeArticleAuthors` (true), `includeArticleVideos` (false), `includeArticleLinks` (false), `includeArticleExtractedDates` (false), `includeArticleDuplicateList` (false), `includeArticleOriginalArticle` (false) |
| Article body length | `articleBodyLen` (int, -1 = full body; default -1). For `getArticle` the name is `infoArticleBodyLen`. The prefixed forms `articlesArticleBodyLen` / `eventsArticleBodyLen` are also accepted. |
| Source | `includeSourceTitle` (true), `includeSourceDescription` (false), `includeSourceLocation` (false), `includeSourceRanking` (false) |
| Concept | `includeConceptLabel` (true), `includeConceptImage` (false), `includeConceptSynonyms` (false), `conceptLang` (string, default `eng`; language of concept labels) |
| Category | `includeCategoryParentUri` (false) |
| Location | `includeLocationGeoLocation` (false; lat/long), `includeLocationPopulation` (false), `includeLocationGeoNamesId` (false), `includeLocationCountryArea` (false; km²), `includeLocationCountryContinent` (false) |
| Event | `includeEventTitle` (true), `includeEventSummary` (false), `includeEventSocialScore` (false), `includeEventSentiment` (true), `includeEventLocation` (true), `includeEventDate` (true), `includeEventArticleCounts` (true), `includeEventConcepts` (true), `includeEventCategories` (true), `includeEventCommonDates` (false), `includeEventStories` (false), `eventImageCount` (int, 0) |
| Story (an event's per-language clusters) | `includeStoryBasicStats`, `includeStoryTitle`, `includeStoryLocation`, `includeStoryDate`, `includeStoryConcepts`, `includeStoryCategories`, `includeStoryMedoidArticle`, `includeStoryCommonDates` (all false), `storyImageCount` (int, 0) |
| Mention | `includeMentionBasicInfo` (true; language, date, time), `includeMentionSlots` (false; entities in the sentence), `includeMentionCategories` (false; categories of the source article), `includeMentionFrameworks` (false; SDG/ESG/SASB of the event type) |

### 1.19 Categories, concepts, sources and locations

- **Concepts**
  - Entities (person, org, loc) or non-entity topics (`wiki`). Wikipedia URLs serve as their URIs.
  - Searching by concept finds mentions in all languages. For example, "White House" and "Casa Blanca" map to the same concept.
  - A concept's score on an **article** ranges from 1 (low relevance) to 5 (high). On a **story or event** it ranges from 0 to 100.
- **Categories**: three taxonomies. Specifying a category also matches its child categories.
  - `dmoz/...`: about 4,300 categories (top 3 DMOZ levels), assigned to English articles only.
  - `news/...`: 8 broad categories such as `news/Business`, `news/Politics` and `news/Technology`, assigned in all languages.
  - IPTC Media Topics: about 1,400 categories in all languages, applied only to articles published from 2026-06-01.
- **Sources**: the source URI is the clean domain name, e.g. `bbc.com`, `theguardian.com`, `nytimes.com`.
- **Locations**: GeoNames-backed places and countries, identified by Wikipedia URL.

### 1.20 Supported languages (ISO 639-3 codes for `lang`)

Albanian `sqi`, Arabic `ara`, Armenian `hye`, Azerbaijani `aze`, Basque `eus`, Belarusian `bel`, Bengali `ben`, Bulgarian `bul`, Catalan `cat`, Chinese `zho`, Croatian `hrv`, Czech `ces`, Danish `dan`, Dutch `nld`, English `eng`, Estonian `est`, Finnish `fin`, French `fra`, Georgian `kat`, German `deu`, Greek `ell`, Gujarati `guj`, Hebrew `heb`, Hindi `hin`, Hungarian `hun`, Icelandic `isl`, Indonesian `ind`, Irish `gle`, Italian `ita`, Japanese `jpn`, Kannada `kan`, Kazakh `kaz`, Korean `kor`, Kurdish `kur`, Latvian `lav`, Lithuanian `lit`, Malayalam `mal`, Marathi `mar`, Norwegian `nob`, Panjabi `pan`, Persian `fas`, Polish `pol`, Portuguese `por`, Romanian `ron`, Russian `rus`, Serbian `srp`, Slovak `slk`, Slovene `slv`, Spanish `spa`, Swedish `swe`, Swiss German `gsw`, Tamil `tam`, Thai `tha`, Turkish `tur`, Ukrainian `ukr`, Urdu `urd`, Vietnamese `vie`.

### 1.21 SDKs and tools

- **Python SDK** (`pip install eventregistry`; https://github.com/EventRegistry/event-registry-python, guides in its wiki):
  - `QueryArticlesIter` / `QueryArticles` for articles
  - `QueryEventsIter` / `QueryEvents` for events
  - `QueryArticle` / `QueryEvent` for item details
  - `QueryMentionsIter` / `QueryMentions` for mentions
  - `Analytics` for text analytics
  - Aggregates are selected with `setRequestedResult()`.
- **Node.js SDK** (`npm install eventregistry`; https://github.com/EventRegistry/event-registry-node-js), with the same classes.
- **MCP server** (https://github.com/EventRegistry/newsapi-mcp): hosted at `https://mcp.newsapi.ai/mcp` (OAuth sign-in; e.g. `claude mcp add --transport http newsapi https://mcp.newsapi.ai/mcp`), or run locally with `npx -y newsapi-mcp` and env `NEWSAPI_KEY` (e.g. `claude mcp add newsapi -e NEWSAPI_KEY=YOUR_API_KEY -- npx -y newsapi-mcp`). Tools: `suggest`, `search` (kind `articles`, `events` or `mentions`), `get_breaking_events`, `get_topic_page_articles`, `get_topic_page_events`, `get_api_usage`.
- **OpenAPI 3 spec**: https://newsapi.ai/static/api.yaml (older than this reference: it lacks NER, mentions, event-type suggestions and usage).

---

## 2. Text Analytics

- **Base URL**: `https://analytics.eventregistry.org/api/v1`.
- **Methods**: GET or POST, with `Content-Type: application/json` for POST.
- **Auth**: all endpoints require `apiKey`.
- **Cost**: charged per document (§1.7).

### Annotate
- Tab: `annotate` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=annotate)
- `GET|POST https://analytics.eventregistry.org/api/v1/annotate`
- **Purpose**
  - Semantically annotates a document: finds the people, locations, organizations and things it mentions.
  - Each annotation carries a unique URI: the Wikipedia URL of the concept.
  - Works in 100+ languages. `url` points to that language's Wikipedia; `secUrl` points to English Wikipedia when available.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `text` | string | required | Text to annotate |
| `minLinkFrequency` | int | 3 | Minimum times a phrase must appear as a link to be a candidate |
| `minLinkRelFrequency` | double | 0.01 | Keep a candidate only if the text points to it with probability above this value (0–1) |
| `nWordsToIgnoreFromList` | int | 200 | Ignore phrases made only of the N most frequent Wikipedia words (0 disables) |
| `minPMentionGivenPhrase` | double | 0.03 | Minimum probability that the phrase, when found on Wikipedia, is annotated with the concept |
| `pageRankSqThreshold` | double | 0.95 | PageRank-based threshold for keeping an annotation |
| `applyPageRankSqThreshold` | boolean | – | Apply `pageRankSqThreshold` |

```json
{ "text": "Microsoft released a new version of Windows OS.", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response (top-level fields):

- `annotations[]`: each item has
  - `url`, `title`, `lang`, `secUrl`, `secTitle`, `secLang`
  - `dbPediaIri`, `dbPediaTypes[]`
  - `type` (e.g. `org`), `wgt`, `pageRank`
  - `wikiDataItemId`, `wikiDataClassIds[]`
  - `support[]` with `{chFrom, chTo, wFrom, wTo, text, pMentionGivenSurface, wikiLang}`
- Token data: `words[]`, `normWords[]`, `spaces[]`, `ranges[]`
- Part-of-speech lists: `verbs[]`, `nouns[]`, `adjectives[]`, `adverbs[]`, each with `{iFrom, iTo, normForm, synsetIds[]}`
- Language detection: `language`, `languageAutodetectInfo`, `languageAutodetectDetails`
- Diagnostics: `settings{...}` and timing fields (`timeTotalMs`, ...)

### Named entity recognition
- `GET|POST https://analytics.eventregistry.org/api/v1/ner`
- **Purpose**
  - Detects named entities in a text (people, organizations, locations, dates, currencies, ...) and returns the text span, character offsets and type of each.
  - Unlike `annotate`, it does not link entities to Wikipedia. It does find entities without a Wikipedia page, such as dates, amounts and lesser-known names.
  - Supports English, German, Spanish and Chinese.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `text` | string | required | Text to analyze |

```json
{ "text": "Microsoft chief executive Satya Nadella visited Berlin on May 5th, 2024.", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `{ "entities": [ { "text": "Microsoft", "startCh": 0, "endCh": 9, "type": "ORGANIZATION" }, { "text": "chief executive", "type": "TITLE", ... }, ... ] }`

### Categorize
- Tab: `categorize` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=categorize)
- `GET|POST https://analytics.eventregistry.org/api/v1/categorize`
- **Purpose**: assigns predefined categories to a text. Results are reliable only for documents of decent size, such as news articles. Taxonomies:
  - `dmoz`: 5000+ categories, 3 levels, English only.
  - `news`: 8 top-level categories, any language.
  - `iptc`: IPTC subject codes, 1000+ categories in 3 levels.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `text` | string | required | Text to categorize |
| `taxonomy` | string | required | `dmoz`, `news` or `iptc` |

```json
{ "text": "Microsoft released a new version of Windows OS.", "taxonomy": "dmoz", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `{ "categories": [ { "label": "dmoz/Business/Investing/Stocks_and_Bonds", "score": 0.123 } ], "keywords": [ { "keyword": "Investing", "wgt": 0.24 } ] }`

### Semantic similarity
- Tab: `semanticSimilarity` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=semanticSimilarity)
- `GET|POST https://analytics.eventregistry.org/api/v1/semanticSimilarity`
- **Purpose**: computes the semantic similarity of two documents, which may be in different languages. The score is based on the people, locations, organizations and things they share.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `text1` | string | required | First text |
| `text2` | string | required | Second text |

```json
{ "text1": "The editor, Carrie Gracie, ... quit her position as China editor ...", "text2": "Paukenschlag bei der britischen BBC: Die China-Expertin Carrie Gracie ...", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `{ "similarity": 0.4046, "annotations1": 15, "annotations2": 13, "totalAnnotations": 22 }`

### Sentiment
- Tab: `sentiment` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=sentiment)
- `GET|POST https://analytics.eventregistry.org/api/v1/sentiment`
- **Purpose**: sentiment of a text from -1 (very negative) to 1 (very positive). Returns the average and per-sentence values. Uses a vocabulary-based or neural-network (`rnn`) method. English only.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `text` | string | required | Text to analyze |
| `method` | string | `vocabulary` | `vocabulary` or `rnn` |
| `sentences` | int | 10 | Number of sentences to compute sentiment on |

```json
{ "text": "Residents and tourists enjoy holiday weekend even as waves start to pound; ...", "method": "rnn", "sentences": 10, "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `{ "avgSent": 0.005, "sentimentPerSent": [0.11, ...], "sentences": ["...", ...] }`

### Extract article information
- Tab: `extractArticleInfo` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=extractArticleInfo)
- `GET|POST https://analytics.eventregistry.org/api/v1/extractArticleInfo`
- **Purpose**: crawls an article URL and returns structured data: title, body, authors, publish date, image, links, videos and other metadata.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `url` | string | required | Article URL |

```json
{ "url": "https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jan/31/this-is-over-puigdemonts-catalan-independence-doubts-caught-on-camera", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response fields:

- Content: `title`, `body`, `description`, `keywords[]`, `authors[]`, `image`, `url`
- Dates: `date`, `time`, `datetime`
- Links and media: `links[]{url, anchorText}`, `videos[]{url, anchorText}`
- Social metadata: `twitterSite`, `twitterSiteId`, `fbSourceUrl`, `fbAuthorUrl`, `fbPages[]`
- Source: `source{url, title}`

### Detect language
- Tab: `detectLanguage` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=detectLanguage)
- `GET|POST https://analytics.eventregistry.org/api/v1/detectLanguage`
- **Purpose**: detects the language of a text. Returns a reliability flag and the most likely languages, with ISO1/ISO3 codes and percentages.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `text` | string | required | Text to analyze |

```json
{ "text": "Microsoft released a new version of Windows OS.", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `{ "reliable": true, "textBytes": 8533, "languages": [ { "name": "LITHUANIAN", "code": "lt", "percent": 99, "score": 1177, "iso1": "lt", "iso3": "lit" } ], "chunks": [ { "name", "code", "offset", "bytes" } ] }`

---

## 3. Articles

### Get articles
- Tab: `searchArticles` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=searchArticles)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/article/getArticles`
- **Purpose**
  - Finds news articles (and/or PR and blogs) that match search conditions given as simple parameters (§1.16) or a `query` object (§1.15).
  - Returns the article list (up to 100 per call; page with `articlesPage`) or an aggregate.
- **Cost**: each call counts as one search action.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `resultType` | string | `articles` | `articles`, `uriWgtList`, `langAggr`, `timeAggr`, `sourceAggr`, `sourceExAggr`, `authorAggr`, `keywordAggr`, `locAggr`, `conceptAggr`, `conceptGraph`, `categoryAggr`, `dateMentionAggr`, `sentimentAggr`, `recentActivityArticles` |
| `articlesPage` | int | 1 | Page (from 1). Used when `resultType=articles` |
| `articlesCount` | int | 100 | Articles per page (max 100) |
| `articlesSortBy` | string | `date` | `date`, `rel`, `sourceImportance`, `sourceAlexaGlobalRank`, `sourceAlexaCountryRank` |
| `articlesSortByAsc` | bool | false | Ascending order |
| `articleBodyLen` | int | -1 | Body length to return (-1 = full) |
| `dataType` | str/str[] | `news` | `news`, `pr`, `blog` |
| `forceMaxDataTimeWindow` | int | – | `7` or `31`: search only the last N days |
| Filters | – | – | All shared article filters in §1.16 (`query`, `keyword`, `conceptUri`, ..., `isDuplicateFilter`, `eventFilter`) |
| Returned details | bool/int | see §1.18 | Article, Source, Concept (+`conceptLang`), Category (`includeCategoryParentUri`) and Location (all 5) groups |

Example: the latest 100 articles mentioning the phrase "Tesla Inc" from US, Canadian and UK sources, excluding paywalled sources, from the last month.

```json
{
  "action": "getArticles",
  "keyword": "Tesla Inc",
  "sourceLocationUri": ["http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States", "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canada", "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom"],
  "ignoreSourceGroupUri": "paywall/paywalled_sources",
  "articlesPage": 1, "articlesCount": 100,
  "articlesSortBy": "date", "articlesSortByAsc": false,
  "dataType": ["news", "pr"],
  "forceMaxDataTimeWindow": 31,
  "resultType": "articles",
  "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY"
}
```

Example with the query language: business articles from 2017-04-22 that mention Barack Obama **or** the keyword "Trump", sorted by relevance.

```json
{
  "query": { "$query": { "$and": [
    { "dateStart": "2017-04-22", "dateEnd": "2017-04-22", "categoryUri": "dmoz/Business" },
    { "$or": [ { "conceptUri": "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barack_Obama" }, { "keyword": "Trump" } ] }
  ] } },
  "articlesPage": 1, "articlesCount": 100, "articlesSortBy": "rel",
  "resultType": "articles", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY"
}
```

Response (one key per `resultType`):

```
{ "articles": { "totalResults", "page", "count", "pages", "results": [Article, ...] } }
uriWgtList:     { totalResults, page, count, pages, results: [string] }
conceptAggr:    { warning?, usedResults, totalResults, results: [Concept] }
keywordAggr:    { ..., results: [{ keyword, weight }] }
timeAggr:       { ..., results: [{ date, count }] }
sourceAggr:     { ..., results: [Source] }
conceptGraph:   { ..., concepts: [Concept], links: [{ uri1, uri2, score }] }
categoryAggr:   { ..., results: [{ label, score }] }
recentActivityArticles: { currTime, activity: [...] }
```

### Get articles for topic page
- Tab: `searchArticlesForTopic` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=searchArticlesForTopic)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/article/getArticlesForTopicPage`
- **Purpose**
  - Returns articles that match a topic page created in the web UI (Media Monitoring page, https://eventregistry.org/monitoring).
  - A topic page is defined by concepts, keywords, sources, categories and other conditions. Not all of them need to match; articles that match more of them rank higher.
  - Its URI appears in the browser URL, e.g. `240f6a12-b9d8-40a6-b1c6-a220e31d08de`.
  - Can also return aggregates.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `uri` | string | required | Topic page URI |
| `resultType` | string | `articles` | Same list as getArticles, without `recentActivityArticles` |
| `maxDaysBack` | int | topic setting | Return no articles older than N days |
| `onlyAfterTm` | string | – | Only articles found after this UTC datetime `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`. Use it for repeated polling without duplicates |
| `articlesPage` | int | 1 | Page |
| `articlesCount` | int | 100 | Max 100 |
| `articlesSortBy` | string | topic relevance | `date`, `rel`, `sourceImportance`, `sourceAlexaGlobalRank`, `sourceAlexaCountryRank` |
| `articlesSortByAsc` | bool | false | Ascending |
| `dataType` | str/str[] | `news` | `news`, `pr`, `blog` |
| Returned details | – | §1.18 | `articleBodyLen`, plus the Article, Source, Concept, Category and Location groups (Location without `includeLocationGeoLocation`) |

```json
{ "uri": "240f6a12-b9d8-40a6-b1c6-a220e31d08de", "resultType": "articles", "articlesCount": 100, "articleBodyLen": -1, "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `{ "articles": { "totalResults", "page", "count", "pages", "results": [Article] } }`. Aggregates have the same shape as in getArticles.

### Get article details
- Tab: `articleDetails` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=articleDetails)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/article/getArticle`
- **Purpose**
  - Returns full details for one or more article URIs (up to 100 per call).
  - The cost equals an article search.
  - URIs come from searches, for example getArticles with `resultType=uriWgtList`.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `articleUri` | str/str[] | required | One article URI or up to 100 |
| `resultType` | string | `info` | `info`, `duplicatedArticles`, `originalArticle` |
| `infoArticleBodyLen` | int | -1 | Body length (-1 = full) |
| Returned details | – | §1.18 | Article, Concept (+`conceptLang`), Source and Location groups (Location without geoLocation; no category parent flag) |

```json
{
  "action": "getArticle",
  "articleUri": ["936059390", "936055095", "936053756", "936053919", "935220287"],
  "infoArticleBodyLen": -1,
  "includeArticleConcepts": true, "includeArticleCategories": true, "includeArticleLocation": true,
  "resultType": "info",
  "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY"
}
```

Response is keyed by article URI:

```
{ "<articleUri>": {
    "info": Article,
    "duplicatedArticles": { totalResults, page, count, pages, results: [Article] },
    "originalArticle": Article } }
```

### Stream of new articles
- Tab: `feedOfArticles` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=feedOfArticles)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/minuteStreamArticles`
- **Purpose**
  - Returns articles added to Event Registry in the last few minutes, optionally filtered by language, source, keyword, concept and so on.
  - Call it repeatedly, every minute or every few minutes.
  - It is the only call that can return more than 100 articles (up to 2,000). It uses 1 token per started 100 returned articles.
  - The docs strongly recommend the `recentActivityArticles*UpdatesAfterUri` parameters, which guarantee no gaps and no duplicates.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `recentActivityArticlesMaxArticleCount` | int | 100 | Max articles to return (≤ 2000). Tokens scale per 100 |
| `recentActivityArticlesNewsUpdatesAfterUri` / `...BlogUpdatesAfterUri` / `...PrUpdatesAfterUri` | string | – | Return only articles added after the article with this URI. Take the value from the previous response's `recentActivityArticles.newestUri.{news,blog,pr}` |
| `recentActivityArticlesUpdatesAfterMinsAgo` | int | – | Look back N minutes (≤ 240). Less reliable than `*UpdatesAfterUri` |
| `recentActivityArticlesUpdatesAfterTm` | string | – | Articles collected after this UTC datetime `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` (≤ 4 hours ago). Less reliable than `*UpdatesAfterUri` |
| `articleBodyLen` | int | -1 | Body length |
| `dataType` | str/str[] | `news` | `news`, `pr`, `blog` |
| Filters | – | – | `keyword`, `conceptUri`, `categoryUri`, `sourceUri`, `sourceLocationUri`, `sourceGroupUri`, `authorUri`, `locationUri`, `lang`, `keywordLoc`, `keywordOper`, `keywordSearchMode`, `conceptOper`, `categoryOper`, `start/endSourceRankPercentile`, `min/maxSentiment`, `isDuplicateFilter`, `eventFilter` (§1.16) |
| Returned details | – | §1.18 | Same groups as getArticles |

Example: continue from the last seen URIs.

```json
{
  "recentActivityArticlesNewsUpdatesAfterUri": "1307141581",
  "recentActivityArticlesBlogUpdatesAfterUri": "1235393368",
  "recentActivityArticlesMaxArticleCount": 2000,
  "lang": ["eng", "deu", "spa"],
  "keyword": ["Tesla", "Elon Musk"], "keywordOper": "or", "keywordLoc": "title",
  "dataType": ["news", "blog"],
  "articleBodyLen": -1, "includeArticleConcepts": true, "includeArticleCategories": true,
  "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY"
}
```

Response:

```
{ "recentActivityArticles": {
    "newestUpdate", "oldestUpdate",
    "newestUri": { "news": "<uri>", "blog": "<uri>", "pr": "<uri>" },
    "currTime",
    "activity": [Article, ...] } }
```

---

## 4. Events

An event is a cluster of articles, possibly in several languages, about the same happening. Event URIs look like `eng-2940883`.

### Get events
- Tab: `searchEvents` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=searchEvents)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/event/getEvents`
- **Purpose**
  - Finds events that match simple parameters (§1.17) or a `query` object (§1.15).
  - Returns the event list (up to 50 per call; page with `eventsPage`) or an aggregate.
- **Cost**: each call counts as one event search action.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `resultType` | str/str[] | `events` | `events`, `uriWgtList`, `timeAggr`, `locAggr`, `locTimeAggr`, `sourceAggr`, `authorAggr`, `keywordAggr`, `conceptAggr`, `conceptGraph`, `categoryAggr`, `breakingEvents`, `sentimentAggr`, `dateMentionAggr`, `recentActivityEvents` |
| `eventsPage` | int | 1 | Page (from 1) |
| `eventsCount` | int | 50 | Events per page (max 50) |
| `eventsSortBy` | string | `date` | `date`, `rel`, `size` |
| `eventsSortByAsc` | bool | false | Ascending |
| `forceMaxDataTimeWindow` | int | – | `7` or `31` |
| Filters | – | – | Event filters (§1.17): `query`, `keyword`, `conceptUri`, `categoryUri`, `sourceUri`, `sourceLocationUri`, `sourceGroupUri`, `authorUri`, `locationUri`, `lang`, `dateStart`, `dateEnd`, `minSentimentEvent`, `maxSentimentEvent`, `minArticlesInEvent`, `maxArticlesInEvent`, `reportingDateStart`, `reportingDateEnd`, `dateMentionStart`, `dateMentionEnd`, `keywordLoc`, `keywordOper`, `keywordSearchMode`, `conceptOper`, `categoryOper`, `ignore*` |
| Returned details | – | §1.18 | Event, Concept (+`conceptLang`), Story, Category (`includeCategoryParentUri`) and Location (4 flags, no geoLocation) groups |

```json
{
  "resultType": "events",
  "sourceUri": "bbc.co.uk",
  "minArticlesInEvent": 30,
  "eventsPage": 1, "eventsCount": 50,
  "eventsSortBy": "date", "eventsSortByAsc": false,
  "forceMaxDataTimeWindow": 31,
  "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY"
}
```

Response:

```
{ "events": { totalResults, page, count, pages, results: [Event] } }
uriWgtList:   { totalResults, page, count, pages, results: [string] }
conceptAggr:  { warning?, usedResults, totalResults, results: [Concept] }
keywordAggr:  { ..., results: [{ keyword, weight }] }
locAggr:      { ..., results: [{ count, concept: { uri, type, label, location } }] }
timeAggr:     { ..., results: [{ date, count }] }
sourceAggr:   { ..., results: [Source] }
conceptGraph: { ..., concepts: [Concept], links: [{ uri1, uri2, score }] }
categoryAggr: { ..., results: [{ label, score }] }
recentActivityEvents: { currTime, activity: [...] }
```

### Get events for a topic page
- Tab: `searchEventsForTopic` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=searchEventsForTopic)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/event/getEventsForTopicPage`
- **Purpose**: returns events that match a topic page created on the monitoring page. Events that match more of the topic's concepts and keywords rank higher. Sorted by topic relevance by default. Can also return aggregates.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `uri` | string | required | Topic page URI |
| `resultType` | str/str[] | `events` | Same list as getEvents, without `recentActivityEvents` |
| `eventsPage` | int | 1 | Page |
| `eventsCount` | int | 50 | Max 50 |
| `eventsSortBy` | string | `rel` | `date`, `rel`, `size` |
| `eventsSortByAsc` | bool | false | Ascending |
| Returned details | – | §1.18 | Same groups as getEvents |

```json
{ "uri": "240f6a12-b9d8-40a6-b1c6-a220e31d08de", "resultType": "events", "eventsSortBy": "rel", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `{ "events": { totalResults, page, count, pages, results: [Event] } }`

### Get event details
- Tab: `eventDetails` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=eventDetails)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/event/getEvent`
- **Purpose**
  - Returns details for one event (`eventUri`).
  - The most common use is retrieving the event's articles (`resultType=articles`).
  - Other result types give summaries: top keywords, sources, mentioned dates, article trend and similar events.
  - Article filters (§1.16) restrict the event's articles to a subset.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `eventUri` | string | required | Event URI |
| `resultType` | str/str[] | `info` | `info`, `articles`, `articleUris`, `keywordAggr`, `sourceExAggr`, `dateMentionAggr`, `articleTrend`, `similarEvents`. The result type is also the prefix for its paging and sorting parameters |
| `articlesLang` | str/str[] | – | With `resultType=articles`: only articles in these languages |
| `articlesIncludeDuplicates` | bool | false | With `resultType=articles`: also return duplicates (copies) of articles |
| `articlesPage`, `articlesCount`, `articlesSortBy`, `articlesSortByAsc`; `articleTrendLang`, `articleTrendPage`, `articleTrendCount` | – | – | Paging and sorting of the `articles` / `articleTrend` results; `articlesSortBy` also accepts `cosSim` (similarity to the event centroid) |
| Filters | – | – | `keyword`, `conceptUri`, `categoryUri`, `sourceUri`, `sourceLocationUri`, `sourceGroupUri`, `authorUri`, `locationUri`, `dateStart`, `dateEnd`, `dateMentionStart`, `dateMentionEnd`, `keywordLoc`, `keywordOper`, `keywordSearchMode`, `conceptOper`, `categoryOper`, `start/endSourceRankPercentile`, `min/maxSentiment` (§1.16) |
| Returned details | – | §1.18 | Event, Concept (+`conceptLang`), Story, Article (+`articleBodyLen`), Source and Location (4 flags) groups |

```json
{
  "eventUri": "eng-2940883",
  "resultType": "articles",
  "articlesPage": 1, "articlesCount": 100,
  "articlesLang": ["eng", "deu", "zho", "slv", "spa"],
  "articlesSortBy": "cosSim", "articlesSortByAsc": false,
  "articlesArticleBodyLen": -1,
  "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY"
}
```

Other doc examples:

- `{ "eventUri": "deu-931031", "resultType": "keywordAggr" }`
- `{ "eventUri": "deu-931031", "resultType": "articleTrend", "articleTrendLang": [...], "articleTrendPage": 1, "articleTrendCount": 100 }`

Response is keyed by event URI:

```
{ "<eventUri>": {
    "info": Event,
    "articles":        { totalResults, page, count, pages, results: [Article] },
    "articleUris":     { totalResults, page, count, pages, results: [string] },
    "keywordAggr":     { warning?, usedResults, totalResults, results: [{ keyword, weight }] },
    "sourceExAggr":    { ..., results: [{ source: Source, counts: {...} }] },
    "dateMentionAggr": { ..., results: [{ date, count }] },
    "articleTrend":    { totalResults, page, count, pages, results: [Article] },
    "similarEvents":   { totalResults, page, count, pages, results: [Event] } } }
```

### Stream of events
- Tab: `feedOfEvents` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=feedOfEvents)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/minuteStreamEvents`
- **Purpose**
  - Returns events added or updated in the last few minutes, optionally filtered.
  - It is the only event call that can return more than 50 events (up to 2,000). It costs 5 tokens per 50 events.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `recentActivityEventsMaxEventCount` | int | 50 | Max events (≤ 2000). Tokens scale per 50 |
| `recentActivityEventsUpdatesAfterMinsAgo` | int | – | Look back N minutes (≤ 240) |
| `recentActivityEventsUpdatesAfterTm` | string | – | Events updated after this UTC datetime `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` (≤ 4 hours ago) |
| Filters | – | – | `keyword`, `conceptUri`, `categoryUri`, `sourceUri`, `sourceLocationUri`, `sourceGroupUri`, `authorUri`, `locationUri`, `keywordLoc`, `keywordOper`, `keywordSearchMode`, `conceptOper`, `categoryOper`, `lang`, `minArticlesInEvent`, `maxArticlesInEvent` (§1.17) |
| Returned details | – | §1.18 | Event, Concept, Story, Article (+`articleBodyLen`), Source and Location groups |

```json
{
  "conceptUri": "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesla,_Inc.",
  "categoryUri": "news/Business",
  "recentActivityEventsUpdatesAfterMinsAgo": 10,
  "recentActivityEventsMaxEventCount": 2000,
  "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY"
}
```

Response: `{ "recentActivityEvents": { "newestUpdate", "oldestUpdate", "activity": ["eng-8624106", "deu-1635754", ...], "eventInfo": { "<eventUri>": Event, ... } } }`

### Get list of breaking events
- Tab: `breakingEvents` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=breakingEvents)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/event/getBreakingEvents`
- **Purpose**: returns breaking events with their breaking score. A breaking event:
  - happened very recently,
  - gathered many articles in a short time, and
  - is reported with increasing intensity.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `breakingEventsCount` | int | 100 | Number of events (max 100) |
| `breakingEventsPage` | int | 1 | Page |
| `breakingEventsMinBreakingScore` | double | 0.2 | Minimum breaking score (≥ 0) |
| Returned details | – | §1.18 | Event, Concept, Story, Category and Location groups (as getEvents) |

```json
{ "eventImageCount": 3, "includeEventLocation": true, "includeEventSocialScore": true, "includeLocationGeoLocation": true, "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `{ "events": { totalResults, page, count, pages, results: [Event] } }`

---

## 5. Signal Types / Event Types (mentions)

- Signal Types (called event types in the API) are available to accounts with Event Types API access; see https://newsapi.ai/signal-types.
- A **mention** is a sentence from an article that describes a relation of interest, called an **event type**. Examples: an acquisition, layoffs, a product release, a natural disaster. The taxonomy has 136+ event types across Business, Society and Environment.

### Get mentions
- Tab: `searchMentions` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=searchMentions)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/eventType/mention/getMentions`
- **Purpose**
  - Finds sentences (mentions) that match event types, concepts, industries, ESG/SDG/SASB frameworks and other conditions.
  - Each mention carries the sentence, sentiment, source, entities (slots), categories and a link to the article.
  - Returns the list (up to 100 per call; page with `mentionsPage`) or an aggregate.
- **Cost**: each call is one search action.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `resultType` | string | `mentions` | `mentions`, `uriWgtList`, `langAggr`, `timeAggr`, `sourceAggr`, `sourceExAggr`, `keywordAggr`, `locAggr`, `locTimeAggr`, `conceptAggr`, `eventTypeAggr`, `categoryAggr`, `sentimentAggr`, `recentActivityMentions` |
| `mentionsPage` | int | 1 | Page |
| `mentionsCount` | int | 100 | Max 100 |
| `mentionsSortBy` | string | `date` | `date`, `rel`, `sourceImportance`, `sourceAlexaGlobalRank`, `sourceAlexaCountryRank` |
| `mentionsSortByAsc` | bool | false | Ascending |
| `query` | object | – | Advanced query (§1.15) with extra fields such as `eventTypeUri` and `industryUri`. `$filter` supports `showDuplicates` |
| `eventTypeUri` | str/str[] | – | Event type(s), OR-combined, e.g. `et/business/acquisitions-mergers/acquisition/approved`. Find URIs with Suggest event types |
| `industryUri` | str/str[] | – | Sentence mentions a company in this industry (OR-combined), e.g. `sectors/Communications` |
| `sdgUri` / `sasbUri` / `esgUri` | str/str[] | – | Event type belongs to an SDG, SASB or ESG framework item, e.g. `sdg/sdg5_gender_equality`, `sasb/environment/air_quality`, `esg/environment` |
| `keyword`, `conceptUri`, `categoryUri`, `sourceUri`, `sourceLocationUri`, `sourceGroupUri`, `locationUri`, `dateStart`, `dateEnd` | – | – | As in §1.16, applied to sentences and their articles |
| `factLevel` | str/str[] | – | `fact`, `opinion`, `forecast` |
| `keywordOper`, `keywordSearchMode`, `conceptOper`, `categoryOper` | string | `and`, `phrase`, `and`, `or` | Operators (§1.16) |
| `ignoreEventTypeUri`, `ignoreIndustryUri`, `ignoreSdgUri`, `ignoreSasbUri`, `ignoreEsgUri`, `ignoreKeyword`, `ignoreConceptUri`, `ignoreCategoryUri`, `ignoreSourceUri`, `ignoreSourceLocationUri`, `ignoreSourceGroupUri`, `ignoreLocationUri` | str/str[] | – | Negative conditions |
| `startSourceRankPercentile` / `endSourceRankPercentile` | int | 0 / 100 | Source-rank window |
| `minSentiment` / `maxSentiment` | float | – | Article sentiment bounds (English only) |
| `minSentenceIndex` / `maxSentenceIndex` | int | – | Sentence position in the article: the title is 0, the first body sentence is 1. Use `max=1` for title or lead only |
| `showDuplicates` | bool | false | Return near-duplicate sentences |
| Returned details | – | §1.18 | `includeMentionBasicInfo`, `includeMentionSlots`, `includeMentionCategories`, `includeMentionFrameworks`, `includeSourceTitle`, `includeSourceLocation`, `includeConceptSynonyms`, `conceptLang`, `includeLocationGeoLocation` |

Example: stock-price mentions for transportation companies in April 2023.

```json
{
  "query": {
    "$query": {
      "eventTypeUri": "et/business/stock-prices/stock-price",
      "industryUri": "sectors/Transportation",
      "dateStart": "2023-04-01", "dateEnd": "2023-04-30"
    },
    "$filter": { "showDuplicates": false }
  },
  "includeArticleSentiment": true, "includeMentionCategories": true,
  "mentionsCount": 100, "mentionsPage": 1,
  "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY"
}
```

Second doc example: `$and` of `{ "eventTypeUri": "et/business/products-services" }` and `{ "conceptUri": { "$or": [Microsoft, OpenAI, Google Wikipedia URLs] } }`.

Response:

```
{ "mentions": { totalResults, page, count, pages, results: [Mention] } }
uriWgtList, conceptAggr, keywordAggr, timeAggr, sourceAggr, categoryAggr: same shapes as getArticles
eventTypeAggr: { warning?, usedResults, totalResults, results: [{ uri, label, count }] }
```

---

## 6. Autosuggest

- **Base**: `https://eventregistry.org`.
- **Purpose**: map labels (names) to the URIs used by search filters.
- **Matching**: case-insensitive. The term can appear anywhere in the label.
- **Parameters**: `apiKey` and `prefix` on all endpoints; the extra parameters listed per endpoint are optional.

### Suggest concepts
- Tab: `suggConcepts` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=suggConcepts)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/suggestConceptsFast`
- **Purpose**: maps a full or partial concept label to concept URIs for `conceptUri`. Results are sorted by frequency in the data; the first candidate is usually the right one.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `prefix` | string | – | Partial or full concept name |
| `lang` | string | – | Language of `prefix` (example: `eng`). With `lang: "ticker"` or `lang: "isin"`, pass the full ticker or ISIN in `name` |
| `name` | string | – | Full ticker (e.g. `OLED`) or ISIN (e.g. `US0378331005`) when `lang` is `ticker`/`isin` |
| `source` | string[] | – | e.g. `["concepts"]` |
| `conceptLang` | str/str[] | – | Label languages to return, e.g. `["eng","deu"]` |
| `page`, `count` | int | – | Paging (e.g. `page: 1`, `count: 20`) |

```json
{ "prefix": "Obama", "source": ["concepts"], "lang": "eng", "conceptLang": ["eng", "deu"], "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
{ "name": "OLED", "lang": "ticker", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: an array of concepts, for example `[ { "uri": "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States", "type": "loc", "score": 81564322, "label": { "eng": "United States (U.S.A.)" }, "location": { "type": "country", "label": {...} } }, ... ]`

### Suggest categories
- Tab: `suggCategories` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=suggCategories)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/suggestCategoriesFast`
- **Purpose**: maps a full or partial category label to category URIs, sorted by frequency.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `prefix` | string | – | Partial or full category name |
| `page`, `count` | int | – | Paging |

```json
{ "prefix": "Business", "page": 1, "count": 20, "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `[ { "uri": "dmoz/Arts", "label": "dmoz/Arts", "parentUri": "dmoz" }, { "uri": "news/Arts_and_Entertainment", "label": "news/Arts and Entertainment", "parentUri": "news" }, ... ]`

### Suggest sources
- Tab: `suggSources` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=suggSources)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/suggestSourcesFast`
- **Purpose**: maps a source name or partial domain to source URIs (clean domain names), sorted by article volume.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `prefix` | string | – | Partial or full source name or domain |

```json
{ "prefix": "BBC", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `[ { "uri": "aa.com.tr", "dataType": "news", "title": "Anadolu Ajansı", "score": 1102763 }, ... ]`

### Suggest authors
- Tab: `suggAuthors` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=suggAuthors)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/suggestAuthorsFast`
- **Purpose**
  - Maps an author name to author URIs, sorted by article count.
  - To disambiguate, add the source domain to the query, e.g. `amy more nytimes.com`.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `prefix` | string | – | Partial or full author name (optionally followed by a domain) |

```json
{ "prefix": "Koenig", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `[ { "uri": "associated_press@marketwatch.com", "name": "Associated Press", "type": "author", "isAgency": true }, ... ]`

### Suggest locations
- Tab: `suggLocations` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=suggLocations)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/suggestLocationsFast`
- **Purpose**: maps a full or partial city or country name to location URIs for `locationUri` and `sourceLocationUri`.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `prefix` | string | – | Partial or full location name |
| `source` | string[] | – | `["place","country"]` |
| `lang` | string | – | Language of `prefix`, e.g. `eng` |
| `countryUri` | string | – | Restrict to a country |
| `count` | int | – | Max suggestions |

```json
{ "prefix": "Lond", "count": 20, "source": ["place", "country"], "lang": "eng", "countryUri": "", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `[ { "type": "country", "wikiUri": "http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slovakia", "label": { "eng": "Slovakia" }, "lat": 48.67, "long": 19.5 }, { "type": "place", "wikiUri": "...Martin,_Slovakia", "label": {...}, "lat", "long", "country": {...}, "score": 60817 }, ... ]`. The `wikiUri` is the location URI.

### Suggest event types
- Tab: `suggEventTypes` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=suggEventTypes)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/eventType/suggestEventTypes`
- **Purpose**: maps a full or partial event type label to event type URIs for `eventTypeUri` in mention queries.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |
| `prefix` | string | – | Partial or full event type name |

```json
{ "prefix": "acquisition", "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `[ { "uri": "et/business/industrial-accidents", "label": "et/business/industrial-accidents" }, ... ]`

---

## 7. Other endpoints

### API usage
- Tab: `usage` (https://newsapi.ai/documentation?tab=usage)
- `GET|POST https://eventregistry.org/api/v1/usage`
- **Purpose**: returns the tokens available in your plan and the tokens already used this month.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | required | API key |

```json
{ "apiKey": "YOUR_API_KEY" }
```

Response: `{ "availableTokens": <int>, "usedTokens": <int> }`

---

## 8. Data models

Many fields appear only when the matching `include*` flag is set (§1.18).

### Article

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `uri` | Unique article id (a string, not necessarily numeric), e.g. `"143701955"` |
| `url` | Web URL |
| `title`, `body` | Title and body (body length is controlled by `articleBodyLen`) |
| `date`, `time`, `dateTime` | When the article was found and serialized (UTC). `dateTime`, e.g. `2013-12-18T11:40:00Z`, increases monotonically as articles are added |
| `dateTimePub` | Publish time from the RSS feed or metadata (not monotonic) |
| `lang` | ISO3 language |
| `isDuplicate` | Whether this is a duplicate of another article |
| `dataType` | `news`, `blog` or `pr` |
| `sentiment` | -1..1 or null (English only) |
| `eventUri` | Event the article belongs to (if any), e.g. `eng-2320588` |
| `storyUri` | Story (cluster) URI (if any) |
| `relevance` | How well the article matches the query; used when sorting by `rel` |
| `image` | Main image URL |
| `source` | Source object |
| `categories[]` | Category objects (`uri`, `label`, `wgt`) |
| `concepts[]` | Concept objects with `score` 1–5 |
| `authors[]` | `{ uri, name, type: "author", isAgency }` |
| `links[]` | URLs extracted from the body |
| `videos[]` | `{ uri, label }` |
| `shares` | `{ facebook, googlePlus, pinterest, linkedIn }` (some networks are discontinued) |
| `duplicateList[]` | URIs of duplicates |
| `originalArticle` | Original article object if this is a duplicate |
| `extractedDates[]` | `{ amb (ambiguous), imp (year imputed), date, dateEnd, detectedDate, posInText, textSnippet }` |
| `location` | Location from the dateline, or null |
| `sim` | Cosine similarity to the story centroid |
| `wgt` | Internal sort value (do not use) |

### Event

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `uri` | Event URI, e.g. `eng-33403979` |
| `totalArticleCount` | Total articles about the event |
| `articleCounts` | Articles per language, e.g. `{ "deu": 82, "eng": 18 }` |
| `relevance` | Match score for `rel` sorting |
| `eventDate` | When the event happened (`YYYY-MM-DD`) |
| `sentiment` | -1..1 or null |
| `socialScore` | Social media impact of the event's articles |
| `images[]` | Image URLs (count set by `eventImageCount`) |
| `title`, `summary` | Objects keyed by language, e.g. `{ "eng": "...", "deu": "..." }` |
| `concepts[]` | Concept objects with `score` 0–100 |
| `categories[]` | Category objects |
| `commonDates[]` | `{ date, freq }`: dates frequently mentioned in the articles |
| `location` | Location object (place with a nested `country`) |
| `stories[]` | Per-language clusters. Fields: `uri`, `lang`, `articleCount`, `title`, `concepts`, `categories`, `location`, `medoidArticle`, `storyDate`, `averageDate`, `extractedDate`, `commonDates`, `images`, `socialScore`, `avgCos`, `variance` |
| `wgt` | Internal (do not use) |

### Mention

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `uri` | Mention id, e.g. `7536951383-0` (article URI plus sentence index) |
| `sentence`, `sentenceIndex` | The sentence and its index (title = 0) |
| `eventType` | `{ uri, label }`, e.g. `et/business/acquisitions-mergers/acquisition/approved` |
| `lang`, `date`, `time`, `dateTime` | Article language and publish time |
| `articleUri`, `articleUrl`, `articleTitle`, `articleImageUrl` | The containing article |
| `articleSentiment`, `sentenceSentiment`, `eventTypeSentiment` | Sentiment scores |
| `isDuplicate`, `isDuplicateOf` | Duplicate sentence flag and original |
| `factLevel`, `factLevelProb` | `fact`, `opinion` or `forecast`, with its probability |
| `frameworks` | `{ sdg, sasb, esg }` |
| `categories[]` | Categories of the article: `{ uri, label, wgt }` |
| `source` | `{ uri, title, ... }` |
| `slots[]` | Entities in the sentence, e.g. `{ uri?, label?, text, type: "org" or "money" or ..., synonyms?: { isin: [...] } }` |
| `location`, `validSlots`, `relevance`, `wgt` | Other fields |

### Concept

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `uri` | Wikipedia URL, e.g. `http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States` |
| `type` | `person`, `loc`, `org` or `wiki` |
| `label` | Labels keyed by language (`conceptLang`) |
| `score` | Relevance for the item (articles 1–5; events and stories 0–100) |
| `image` | Image URL |
| `synonyms` | Synonyms keyed by language, e.g. `{ "eng": ["USA","U.S.A."] }` |
| `location` | For location concepts, a Location object |
| `trendingScore` | `{ news: { score, testPopFq, nullPopFq } }` when requested |

### Category

`{ "uri": "dmoz/Society/Issues/Warfare_and_Conflict", "parentUri": "dmoz/Society/Issues", "label": "Society/Issues/Warfare_and_Conflict" }`. On articles and events each category also has `wgt`.

### Source

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `uri` | Domain, e.g. `bbc.co.uk` |
| `dataType` | `news`, `pr` or `blog` |
| `title`, `description` | Name and description |
| `location` | Location object of the publisher; `locationValidated` flag |
| `ranking` | `importanceRank` (0–1,000,000; lower is more important), `alexaGlobalRank`, `alexaCountryRank` |
| `socialMedia` | e.g. `{ "twitter": "BBCNews" }` |
| `image`, `thumbImage` | Logos |

### Location

- **Place**:
  - Identity: `type: "place"`, `wikiUri`, `geoNamesId`, `featureCode` (e.g. `P.PPLA`)
  - Details: `label{lang}`, `lat`, `long`, `population`
  - `country`: a nested country object
- **Country**:
  - Identity: `type: "country"`, `wikiUri`, `geoNamesId`, `label{lang}`
  - Codes: `code2`, `code3`, `webExt`
  - Geography: `area` (km²), `continent`, `lat`, `long`, `population`
  - Currency: `currencyCode`, `currencyName`
- Optional fields are controlled by the `includeLocation*` flags.
